¶Austria es un país con una enorme tradi: Austria has a long hunting tradition and very strict game management. In the same area you can stalk [[red deer]], [[chamois]], [[ibex]], [[fallow deer and mouflon]], plus [[wild boar]].
El paquete son cuatro días de caza 1×1,: The package is four days' hunting one-to-one, with five warthog per hunter and everything included, for €3,500. An accompanying non-hunter pays €600.
Cada facochero adicional cuesta 350 €, t: Each extra warthog costs €350, wounded ones included, and each extra day's hunting €300. By law no more than ten warthog can be charged. A second firearm adds €150 for the permit, and skull preparation is €50 per animal.
Está a pocas horas de vuelo de Madrid, c: It is only a few hours' flight from Madrid, with almost no time difference. The perfect plan for a group of friends who want a short, fun African safari with plenty of hunting.
Cinco por cazador. Los adicionales cuest: Five per hunter. Extra ones cost €350 each, up to a legal maximum of ten.
¿Cada cazador tiene su propio guía?: Does each hunter have his own guide?
Sí, la caza es 1×1: cada cazador sale co: Yes, the hunting is one-to-one: each hunter goes out with his own professional hunter, vehicle and trackers.
Mauritania es el destino perfecto para e: Mauritania is the perfect place to start bowhunting in Africa without spending much. We stalk warthog in the south of the country, 110 km from Nouakchott, in a safe, malaria-free area.
El paquete son cuatro días de caza 1×1 c: The package is four days' hunting one-to-one with five warthog included, for €3,500, the same price as with a rifle. Each extra warthog costs €350 and an accompanying non-hunter €600.
Aparte van los vuelos, el visado (55 €): Flights, the visa (€55) and the veterinary certificate for the trophies (€125) are extra. You stay in a luxury camp with full board.
La zona de caza, en el sur del país, es: The hunting area, in the south of the country, is safe and also free of malaria.
El paquete incluye cinco. Puede añadir m: The package includes five. You can add more at €350 each, up to a legal maximum of ten.
¶El facochero mauritano es abundante y d: The Mauritanian [[warthog]] is plentiful and gives lots of chances to shoot. The season runs from November to March, with dry, pleasant weather, in a safe area in the south of the country.
¶El facochero se caza por la mañana y po: The [[warthog]] is hunted morning and afternoon, approaching on foot while it feeds. It is very lively hunting: you see lots of animals every day and have to judge the wind and every step to get to the right distance.
Le ponemos en contacto con el taxidermis: We put you in touch with the taxidermist and the freight agent, and advise you on CITES permits when the species needs them. The import paperwork is the hunter's responsibility, but we help you through the whole process.
Sí. Los permisos de exportación e import: Yes. Export and import permits, including CITES when the species requires it, are the hunter's responsibility, but we advise you and help you at every step.
